reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no counterparty comment — exactly what is expected for a compliant finding.

The cited provisions (Section 3.6 at p0131, Section 3.4(e) at p0146, Article XIV assistance at p0446, Regulation AB deliverables at p0437) all impose review/access obligations on Cellco as Servicer/Custodian in favour of the Issuer, Depositor and trustees; none creates an audit, inspection or verification right binding our party, so there is no audit exposure for the rule to cap.

No walk-away trigger is present in the cited text: there is no unlimited, unannounced or remote-access right running against us; the Custodian-to-Servicer access at p0146 is internal to the counterparty's own capacities.
Deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') passes, consistent with the once-per-calendar-year, reasonable-notice, on-site, business-hours framing of the review rights we hold.

Rationale correctly notes the sub-elements short of preferred wording (silence on cost allocation, subjection to the Servicer's policies) as commentary only, since those rights benefit us and are outside the rule's protective scope — appropriately not flagged as deviations.
